title: The Customer Isn't Always King. Your Staff Are.

scenes.say: The customer is always right, they say. Not always.
A guest who yells at your barista isn't right. And your whole team is watching what you do next.

props.caption: Hot *take*
props.fact: A guest who yells at your barista is not right

scenes.say: One rude guest is one visit. A barista who knows you've got their back stays, and looks after hundreds of good guests.

scenes.speaker: Dev
scenes.say: When the boss backs you up, you stay.

props.name: Dev
props.quote: When the boss backs you up, you *stay*.

scenes.say: Look after your staff, and they look after your guests. Agree? Follow for more owner tips.
